title: #059. Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem (MDVRP)
subtitle: Route vehicles from D capacitated depots so every route returns to its origin depot without exceeding fleet or supply caps.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { routes, totalDistance }.
judge.m1: Field "routes" must be an array of routes.
judge.m2: Route {p0} must be an integer array of length at least 3 ([d, ..., d]).
judge.m4: Route {p0} started at depot {p1} but ended at {p2}; each route must return to its origin depot.
judge.m6: Customer index {p0} is out of valid range [{p1}, {p2}].
judge.m7: Customer {p0} is visited more than once.
judge.m10: Customer {p0} was not visited by any route.
judge.m11: Reported totalDistance ({p0}) does not match computed route distance ({p1}).
judge.m12: Feasible MDVRP routes, but totalDistance ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
